scoring_justification: Headline quantities are from DFT/EOS fitting; full recompute infeasible in verifier sandbox, so result-level comparison with tolerances is used.

hidden_assets.purpose: Reference equilibrium properties for CoSn and ground-state structure name
hidden_assets.generation_method: Extracted directly from the published paper's Table 1.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Values are the actual DFT results reported in the paper; no synthetic data is used.

outputs.description: Equilibrium structural parameters for the five TaN phases extracted from Birch-Murnaghan equation of state fitting.
Name of the ground-state TaN structure (lowest cohesive energy).

output_contract.notes: The checker compares the CoSn row properties to hidden reference values with tolerances and verifies that CoSn has the lowest cohesive energy among all five structures. The ground-state text file must match the exact expected string.
